weapons: Celestial Bolt Ballista (30", A2, AP(1), Deadly(3))

Keywords.Warden: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away and take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).
Keywords.Breath Attack: Once per activation, before attacking, roll one die. On a 2+ one enemy unit within 6" in line of sight takes 1 hit with Blast(3) and AP(1).
Keywords.Infiltrate: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3” away from enemy unit.
Keywords.Lacerate: When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.
Keywords.Melee Slayer: When this model charges, its weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.
Keywords.Piercing Target: Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. Friendly units get +AP(X) on their weapons when attacking it.
Keywords.Unpredictable Fighter: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.
Keywords.Warden Boost: If all models in this unit have Warden, enemy hits always count as having AP(-1) from Warden (instead of only when being shot/charged from over 9" away).

Eternal Wardens Spells.Shock Attack (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Unstoppable when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).
Eternal Wardens Spells.Thunder Clap (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 1 hit with Lacerate.
Eternal Wardens Spells.Star Strike (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Unpredictable Fighter once (next time the effect would apply).
Eternal Wardens Spells.Heavy Storm (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each.
Eternal Wardens Spells.Warding Cloud (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Warden Boost once (next time the effect would apply).
Eternal Wardens Spells.Lightning Bolt (3): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 3 hits with Blast(3) and Lacerate.
